name: Bagels
summary: Stiff, low hydration, boiled before baking.

steps.text: Mix a very stiff dough. It will fight the mixer.
Bulk one hour, divide and shape rings.
Cold retard the shaped rings overnight.
Boil 45 seconds a side in malted water, then seed and bake.

bake.notes: Boil longer for a chewier crust. Do not skip the malt.

notes: 56% hydration feels wrong in the bowl and right in the mouth.
